name: Risk:Reward Visualizer
when_to_pick: Show a trade's entry, stop-loss and take-profit as a proportional price ladder: the risk zone (entry → SL, red) and reward zone (entry → TP, green) are shaded to scale so the reader sees the asymmetry at a glance, with a prominent reward-to-risk readout and the break-even win rate it implies. Direction (long/short) is detected automatically. Inputs are editable, so the visual updates live as the reader experiments with stop placement. Pick it when explaining position sizing, R-multiples, stop discipline, or why a higher R:R lets a lower win rate stay profitable.

instrument.description: Instrument symbol shown for context (display only; does not affect math).

sl_default.description: Stop-loss price. Below entry = long, above entry = short (direction is auto-detected from SL/TP vs entry).

decimals.description: Price precision (e.g. 4 for FX majors, 2 for indices, 0 for JPY-quoted lots).

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the visual (plain text).
